messages:
Priya (Product): Quick follow-up from todays all-hands security section. Customers asked for clarity on KMS/BYOK rotation, HSM support for Private, DSAR ownership, and ISO evidence timelines. Can we capture answers here?
Leah (Head of Security): Short answers incoming.
Priya (Product): Thanks.
Leah (Head of Security): KMS/BYOK: Private + Dedicated support customer-managed keys. Recommended rotation is 90 days; we won't force automatic rewrap. We will offer an opt-in managed rotation service.
Anya (Compliance): For SOC2/ISO evidence we need rotation logs, key version history, and access trails. Plan: expose CSV exports in Console.
Kai (Eng-Infra): HSMs: we support on-prem HSMs via a KMIP connector agent. GA depends on pilot integrations and security certification.
Priya (Product): ETA for HSM GA?
Jordan (CTO): Target end of Q3, contingent on 2 pilot customers in May/June.
Sam (Privacy): DSARs: Hosted API - metadata retention per policy, payloads ephemeral unless retained by customer. Private/Dedicated - customer owns data; Redwood provides metadata export tools.
Priya (Product): Immutable audit replicas?
Kai (Eng-Infra): We can replicate audit logs to S3/GCS with versioning; WORM depends on storage provider features. We'll publish configuration recipes.
Anya (Compliance): ISO evidence roadmap (soft dates): June - export templates; August - self-serve evidence bundles; Sept - auditor-access toggles.
Leah (Head of Security): Action items: Leah to write BYOK FAQ + policy blurb; Kai to publish HSM pilot checklist and signup; Anya to publish ISO evidence timeline.
Priya (Product): Drop links to drafts here so I can share with customers.
Kai (Eng-Infra): HSM draft: https://internal.redwood/hsm-design (internal). Pilot signup: https://forms.redwood/hsm-pilot (internal).
Leah (Head of Security): BYOK FAQ draft: https://internal.redwood/byok-faq (internal).
Anya (Compliance): ISO checklist draft: https://internal.redwood/iso-evidence-checklist (internal).
Sam (Privacy): I'll paste a short DSAR blurb shortly.
Priya (Product): Need explicit DSAR ownership statement for Private deployments.
Leah (Head of Security): Policy: for Private (VPC/on-prem) where customer controls KMS/network/storage, the customer is responsible for DSAR responses. Redwood will assist with metadata exports and platform logs. We'll publish a one-paragraph policy.
Jordan (CTO): Note: Dedicated/Private customer contracts will include timeboxed DSAR support; scope negotiable in procurement.
Kai (Eng-Infra): HSM caveat: if keys never leave the HSM, some forensic traces live only in HSM audit logs; customers should coordinate with their HSM operator for those traces.
Priya (Product): Please file tickets for the action items.
ops-bot: Created SEC-421 "BYOK FAQ + policy blurb" and SEC-422 "HSM pilot checklist".
Leah (Head of Security): I'll take SEC-421.
Kai (Eng-Infra): I'll take SEC-422.
Anya (Compliance): I'll open SEC-423 for ISO evidence tasks and link it here when done.
Sam (Privacy): DSAR blurb posted: "Hosted: Redwood retains request metadata; payloads are ephemeral unless customer opts in. Private: customer-controlled deployments - customer owns DSAR responses; Redwood provides exports and support within contracted assistance windows."
Priya (Product): Great. I'll assemble a customer-facing bundle when drafts are ready. Thanks all.
Leah (Head of Security): Closing the loop. For NDA-level requests, route via Legal.
ops-bot: Updated tickets: SEC-421 assigned to Leah, SEC-422 assigned to Kai, SEC-423 pending (Anya).
